Class BasketDAOPostgres

java.lang.Object
ry.ms.persistLogic.basket.postgres.BasketDAOPostgres
All Implemented Interfaces:
BasketDAO
public class BasketDAOPostgres extends Object implements BasketDAO
PostgreSQL implementation of the BasketDAO interface. Handles persistence of basket items using a PostgreSQL database.
